user.title: Add a place
user.description: SanAlert shows whether drones or missiles tracked across the border are heading for this place. It is not an official warning system: it does not replace sirens, Alert RCB or instructions from the services. The place stays in Home Assistant; it only fetches the public state document that everybody gets.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SanAlert. Try again in a moment.
error.outside_poland: SanAlert works out levels for Poland only. Choose a place in Poland.

abort.already_configured: This place (its ~11 km square) is already added.
